name: Miháld (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of tan triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Miháld (a light blue and green shield with a crown and a stag's head) below the year 1121 in tan.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
